subject.title: fix(telegram): hard-split oversize markdown chunks that markdown-awar…

question: Should this rich-message-only Telegram fallback PR wait for live Telegram delivery proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly waive that proof gate?
rationale: Scoped Telegram policy and prior ClawSweeper state require real Telegram proof for visible delivery changes, but only maintainers can waive that gate or decide the rich-only scope is not worth landing separately.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram screenshot, recording, transcript, or logs showing an oversized rich-mode Markdown reply delivered as multiple complete messages before merge.

options.title: Waive proof and merge after rebase
options.body: A maintainer may accept the helper-level proof and own the remaining delivery risk after the branch is refreshed and the PR body is scoped to rich messages.

options.title: Close as not worth separate landing
options.body: If maintainers consider the linked default issue fully handled by the merged default-path fix, this PR can be closed with an invitation for a fresh rich-mode proof-backed PR later.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram screenshot, recording, transcript, or logs showing an oversized rich-mode Markdown reply delivered as multiple complete messages before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the rich-message path and the merged default long-reply fix, so they are best placed to judge proof sufficiency and scope.
